response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS b FROM g), kept AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_mod, base.b FROM g, base WHERE g.avg_mod > base.b) SELECT status, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - b AS above_baseline, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Signals with a NULL rfistat form their own group, and that group appears with a NULL status. Empty-string statuses, if any, are treated as a real status value.

The baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-status averages, and each status counts once. A group whose modindex values are all NULL has a NULL average, so it is excluded from the baseline and from the kept statuses.
